Aap pattern dekh rahe hain: beech ka 5, dono taraf ghatte numbers. Ab in jodon ko milaiye: 1+1, 2+2, 3+3, 4+4, phir beech ka 5.
Aapne pairs jodkar total nikala. Upar aur neeche: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 kitna hai? Yeh kis tarah ka number hai?

Haan, aapka 25 bilkul sahi hai: 5 times 5, isliye yeh square number hai. Stadium mein square grid ki lights stages mein jalti hain: pehle 1, phir 3 aur, phir 5 aur, aise hi 29 aur tak. Kul kitni lights jalengi? Sab numbers alag-alag jodne ke bajay pattern use kariye.
Pattern mein odd numbers kram se aate hain: 1, 3, 5, 7… 19. Aap inhe jodkar total ko 10 times 10 se milaiye.
Aap 10 terms gin chuke hain; ab square number ka pattern bolkar poora kijiye.
